description: Return the Xquik account this connection is authenticated as. Takes no arguments. The id stays the same across token refresh, reconnection & permission changes.
name: whoami

email.description: Email address for display, never the profile identity.

id.description: Opaque profile identifier. Unique within Xquik, unchanged across token refresh & reconnection, & never reassigned to another account.

name.description: Display name for the authenticated account.

title: Current Xquik account
